https://atid.store.core_purpose: The website serves as an e-commerce platform enabling users to browse, purchase, and manage fashion and lifestyle products online.
business_requirements: Users must be able to browse and filter products by categories, price range, and other attributes.
Users must be able to view detailed product information, including images, descriptions, and pricing, on individual product pages.
Users must be able to add products to a shopping cart and proceed to checkout with multiple payment options.
Users must be able to create and manage personal accounts to save shipping addresses, payment methods, and order history.
Users must receive confirmation emails and updates for successful orders and shipping status.
Administrators must be able to manage inventory, product listings, and promotional campaigns through a backend system.
Users must be able to contact customer support or access FAQs for assistance with orders or site functionality.
